messages:
sam: opened PR 4120 to add 'micro-edge' install guide for sealed sites. Needs quick docs review, especially networking and HSM snippets. @anya @sre-ops
anya: skimmed. Good direction. Please include both nftables and minimal iptables fallbacks (we still see both in customer infra).
anya: nftables example: ```nft add table inet redwood && nft add chain inet redwood forward { type filter hook forward priority 0; policy drop; } && nft add rule inet redwood forward ct state established,related accept && nft add rule inet redwood forward tcp dport {443,22} accept```
sre-ops: add note: minimal profile only requires 443 (https) and 22 (ssh) outbound for bundle import + optional 8443 for local kms-proxy if using socket proxy. Do not list tracing ports.
devrel: HSM note: installer reads PKCS11_LIB_PATH. Document vendor examples (SoftHSM, SafeNet, CloudHSM shim) and call out that pkcs11 path can vary. Recommend using kms-proxy when you cannot mount /dev entries into the container.
sam: adding systemd drop-in example to bind HSM device into the installer container: ```ini [Service] BindPaths=/dev/eph-hsm:/dev/pkcs11 Restart=on-failure ```
anya: Also add quick checksum step for offline bundles: `sha256sum /tmp/redwood-offline-*.tar.gz` and verify against signed manifest.
docs-bot: CI reminder: add changelog header "Docs: micro-edge sealed install (PR 4120)" and include ci/docs-smoke-789 in smoke-tests matrix. Linkcheck flagged /internal/private/install -> should be /docs/private/edge-install.md
sre-ops: small QA: include SELinux tip: `chcon -t container_file_t /dev/pkcs11` and mention adding installer user to hsm group if permission denied.
sam: thanks all, I'll push linkfix + changelog + iptables fallback then request final review. docs-bot: re-run linkcheck on push.
